title: Early Morning Sunwatch
text:
🌅 Early Morning Sunwatch — October 08, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.6 (Peaked October 08, 2026 at 00:59 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 360 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.00)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

There's some extra energy in Earth's neighborhood! ⚡🌎📡🚀

A bright active region stands out on the Sun today, alongside several small sunspot groups and broad dark coronal structures.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
